name: @brianjenkins94/vscode-theme
description: Web Awesome with VS Code's look: VS Code's default themes' colours (a fixed copy of Default Light+ and Dark+), Web Awesome's tokens mapped onto them, and its components drawn as VS Code's; inside VS Code or a webview it follows the live colour theme, anywhere else the system's mode. Web Awesome itself is optional: without it, the look's tokens still style the published components.
